# Draft:Battle of Pantasma

The Battle of Pantasma refers to two separate armed raids conducted by Contra forces against Sandinista positions in Pantasma during the Contra War, occurring in 1983 and again in 1987.
Background
Pantasma lies in a mountainous area of northern Nicaragua that saw repeated military activity during the conflict.
Engagements
Both incidents involved attacks on government facilities followed by Contra withdrawals.
Aftermath
The engagements demonstrated the continued presence of Contra forces in the region.
